data.description:
Turn the planning artifacts into a committed repository that every later task branches from. This is the only task that commits directly on master.

Why: the repo has zero commits. Branch-per-task (docs/SPEC.md §2) needs a base. Everything after this task is a feature branch merged with --no-ff.

Scope:
- Root .gitignore (Go, Node, *.db, .DS_Store, .env, dist/, plus the .lattice/.gitignore'd runtime paths are already handled inside .lattice/).
- .editorconfig (2-space for ts/json/yaml/md, tabs for go, LF, final newline).
- Move sample_listings.json to data/sample_listings.json (SPEC §3). Nothing else references it yet.
- Create backend/ and frontend/ as empty directories with a .gitkeep each, and docs/ (already has SPEC.md).
- Makefile skeleton with phony targets up, down, dev-api, dev-web, test, lint, check, smoke, dist. Targets that have nothing to run yet print "not yet implemented" and exit 1 so make check fails loudly until BC-2/BC-7 fill them in.
- README.md with the project name "Brillio Listings", one paragraph on what it is, and a "Status: scaffolding" line. BC-15 writes the real README.
- Commit everything present (CLAUDE.md, agents.md, BRANDING.md, docs/, data/, the two PDFs, .lattice/ board state) as the initial commit on master with message "chore: bootstrap repository". No emoji in the message (BRANDING.md §8).

Out of scope: any Go or TypeScript code, Docker files, CI.

Acceptance:
- git log shows exactly one commit on master containing the files above.
- git status is clean afterward.
- make check exits non-zero with a clear "not yet implemented" message.
- data/sample_listings.json exists and the root copy is gone.

Validation: N/A (no running system); record a one-line justification with --role validation.
data.title: Repo bootstrap: initial commit, layout, Makefile, tooling baseline

data.body: Plan-review triage (art_01M4VZCP6DE9BHWCKJFNH2D1G2, PASS, 4 minor): all obvious, all resolved in the plan's 'Plan-Review Cycle 1 Resolutions' block — (1) SCRATCH defined as /tmp/bc1-scratch; (2) dropped /backend/api from .gitignore (would hide a future package; check-ignore count 27->26); (3) Risks file count corrected to 79; (4) use git rev-list --count instead of padded wc -l. No evolutionary or complex findings.

own-reviewer fallback: lattice code-review skipped per BC-1 card exception 7 (initial-commit diff includes PDFs and the whole board and exceeds review_max_diff_chars); fresh-context reviewer sub-agent reviewed f4f8a0b. Verdict PASS-WITH-NITS. Routing: both nits (unignored backend/api binary from a plain go build; Go coverage filenames beyond coverage.out) are skipped in BC-1 with justification — the reviewer recommends no BC-1 change, and both depend on BC-2's choice of build output path and test-api coverage filename. Forwarded to BC-2 as a comment. No code changed, so the PASS names the current HEAD f4f8a0b.

BC-1 complete, handed to Orchestrator. Built: single commit f4f8a0b 'chore: bootstrap repository' on master (81 files: 14 non-board + 67 .lattice board files). Authored .gitignore (35 lines; ignores Go tmp/bin/test binaries, node_modules, frontend/dist, *.db/*.db-*, .DS_Store, .env*, /dist/, coverage; does not ignore .lattice/ or data/), .editorconfig, Makefile (13 phony targets in per-ticket blocks: BC-1 gate composites, BC-2 api, BC-7 web, BC-13 compose, BC-17 dist; each stub prints 'not yet implemented: <target> (lands in BC-N)' to stderr; make check exits 2), README.md stub, backend/.gitkeep, frontend/.gitkeep; moved sample_listings.json to data/ (mode 0600->0644, content unchanged). Deviations: card says stubs exit 1 — recipes do, make itself exits 2; dropped /backend/api from .gitignore (plan-review). No SPEC edits. Findings routed: plan-review 4 minor fixed in plan; code-review 2 nits forwarded to BC-2. No follow-up tickets created. Footgun reported to Orchestrator: host global core.excludesFile ignores *.out/*.log/*.zip/*.env.
